entities.name: António Arnault
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: António Duarte Arnaut, GOL was a Portuguese poet, fiction writer, essayist, lawyer, and politician. He was Minister of Social Affairs in the II Constitutional Government of Portugal, led by Mário Soares. He is considered the "father" of the Portuguese national health service, having created the first basic health law in Portugal and contributed to universal access to medical care for all Portuguese.
